title: Gear
subtitle: A hub with teeth
description: A round hub with eight teeth standing off it: the busiest silhouette in the set, and the one that made the icon fit exact.

A row through a tooth is wider than the gap row nearer the middle, so a search that only checked the edges of a candidate square would put the icon through the outline. The fit here asks every row instead.
